name: Grand Hyatt Chengdu
positioning: French mansion-inspired Grand Hyatt on historic Chunxi Road in central Chengdu, near Tai Koo Li and Kuanzhai Alleys
best_for: Travelers who want a central Chengdu base on a historic shopping street
Guests who value suites with Club access and city views

facts.text: The hotel is on Chunxi Road, a commercial road in Chengdu with over 100 years of history.
The hotel neighbors Tai Koo Li and the traditional landmark Kuanzhai Alleys.
The hotel is close to TianFu Square and the city center; the Chengdu Research Base of Giant Panda Breeding is about a 30-minute drive.
The hotel's architectural design is inspired by France.
Rooms have a separate rain shower and bathtub and Balmain bath amenities.
The Grand Executive Suite has a separate living area, walk-in closet and Club access.
The indoor heated pool is open year-round.
The 24-hour fitness center has a complete range of equipment and six private rooms.
Salon is a French residential-style lounge with all-day piano performances.
Xi Mi is a modern cabaret-style bar with live performance and a Maze garden with the city as a backdrop.
The hotel has more than 3,000 square meters of flexible event space.

highlights.text: The hotel is inspired by the mansions and stately homes of France.
Room types include a double-height Atrium Deluxe Room.
All rooms have floor-to-ceiling picture windows with a bird's-eye view of downtown Chengdu.
The Presidential Suite features a full kitchen, gym, jetted tub, butler service and Club access.
#8 serves Sichuan hot pot and local dishes; guests enter through a 'Market' where they can see fresh produce prepared by chefs.

considerations.text: The hotel recommends local mapping apps such as Gaode Map or Baidu Map, as international mapping apps may not be accurate in Chinese Mainland.
Chengdu Tianfu International Airport is 63 kilometers from the hotel.
WhataHotel notes the large hotel size may feel less intimate.
